# Token list helpers

`tools/server/token-utils.h` provides small header-only helpers for comparing token lists (`std::vector<llama_token>`). All functions are `inline` and take their arguments by const reference.

```cpp
#include "token-utils.h"
```

## `common_prefix_len`

```cpp
size_t common_prefix_len(const std::vector<llama_token> & a, const std::vector<llama_token> & b);
```

Returns the length of the longest common prefix of the two lists, i.e. the number of leading tokens they share. Returns 0 if either list is empty or the first tokens differ.

```cpp
const std::vector<llama_token> a = { 1, 2, 3, 4 };
const std::vector<llama_token> b = { 1, 2, 5, 6 };

const size_t n = common_prefix_len(a, b); // n = 2
```

## `common_suffix_len`

```cpp
size_t common_suffix_len(const std::vector<llama_token> & a, const std::vector<llama_token> & b);
```

Returns the length of the longest common suffix of the two lists, i.e. the number of trailing tokens they share. Returns 0 if either list is empty or the last tokens differ.

```cpp
const std::vector<llama_token> a = { 1, 2, 3, 4 };
const std::vector<llama_token> b = { 9, 8, 3, 4 };

const size_t n = common_suffix_len(a, b); // n = 2
```

## `lcp_similarity`

```cpp
float lcp_similarity(const std::vector<llama_token> & a, const std::vector<llama_token> & b);
```

Returns the common prefix length as a fraction of `b`'s size, in the range `[0, 1]`. Returns 0 if `b` is empty. Note that the fraction is taken with respect to the second argument, so the argument order matters.

```cpp
const std::vector<llama_token> a = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };
const std::vector<llama_token> b = { 1, 2, 5, 6 };

const float sim = lcp_similarity(a, b); // sim = 2 / 4 = 0.5f
```

## Tests

The helpers are covered by assert-based unit tests in `tools/server/tests/unit/test-token-utils.cpp` (empty inputs, identical lists, partial matches, and lists of different lengths).
